summary.headline: Planetary Animal and Plant Allotments
summary.text: Folio 44v lists animals and plants allotted to Kronos, Zeus, and Ares: dragons, snakes, scorpions, nocturnal birds, onions, garlic, wheat, barley, rice, spelt, pungent herbs, and pomegranates. The apparatus records corrections by Kroll and a marginal note by Valla, with comparison to the Florentine codex.
